data.narrative:
Causaly is a Series B biotech and health technology company that has raised $95M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the same sector, with particular focus on 4 directly comparable private companies at Series B/C stages: Eikon Therapeutics ($539M), New Limit ($3.1B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B).

Two triangulation methods were applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implied a $180M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company comparable set yielded a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-company P/S anchoring was not applied due to absence of revenue data. These two methods produced a triangulated range with a low of $153M, median of $1.8B, and high of $4.0B.

The wide dispersion—driven principally by the peer set's heterogeneity—reflects material uncertainty around Causaly's relative positioning within the biotech innovation landscape. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor, while peer medians suggest substantially higher value. Resolution of this range depends critically on revenue traction, IP defensibility, and near-term funding stage trajectory.
